metadata.title: Continuity of Operations

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for sustaining essential institutional functions during and after disruption.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Continuity planning, alternate operations, and crisis coordination technologies.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for sustaining mission-essential functions during prolonged or systemic disruption.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Continuity of operations mitigates ATT&CK impact tactics that degrade organizational availability and governance.

props.name: defense-framework
props.remarks: Continuity aligns with D3FEND mission assurance and organizational resilience techniques.

metadata.remarks: Continuity of Operations defines the capability to maintain essential institutional functions during disruption through alternate processes, degraded modes of operation, and resilient coordination. Control implementation is expressed at the capability level to ensure continuity planning is actionable and auditable.

components.title: Essential Function Identification
components.description: Identification and prioritization of mission-essential functions that must continue during disruption.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Mission-essential functions are identified, documented, and maintained as part of continuity planning.

components.title: Alternate Operating Modes
components.description: Defined degraded, manual, or alternate methods for performing essential functions when normal operations are impaired.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Alternate processing and operating capabilities support continuity during system or facility disruption.

components.title: Continuity Communications
components.description: Reliable coordination and communication mechanisms to support leadership and operational continuity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Communications capabilities are maintained to support command, coordination, and decision-making during disruption.
